WITH
movie_kind AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM kind_type
    WHERE kind = 'movie'
),
us_companies AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM company_name
    WHERE country_code = '[us]'
),
prod_types AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM company_type
    WHERE kind = 'production companies'
),
company_movies AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id, uc.name
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN us_companies AS uc ON uc.id = mc.company_id
    JOIN prod_types AS pt ON pt.id = mc.company_type_id
),
rating_type AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'rating'
),
rating_movies AS (
    SELECT miidx.movie_id, miidx.info
    FROM movie_info_idx AS miidx
    JOIN rating_type AS rt ON rt.id = miidx.info_type_id
),
release_type AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM info_type
    WHERE info = 'release dates'
),
release_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN release_type AS rlt ON rlt.id = mi.info_type_id
)
SELECT MIN(cm.name) AS producing_company,
       MIN(rm.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie
FROM title AS t
JOIN movie_kind AS mk ON mk.id = t.kind_id
JOIN company_movies AS cm ON cm.movie_id = t.id
JOIN rating_movies AS rm ON rm.movie_id = t.id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM release_dates AS rd
    WHERE rd.movie_id = t.id
)
